slow.title: Pace multiplier at 1.2 — 20% slower than reference time
slow.body:
At this pace, daily hiking hours may become excessive, increasing the risk of hiking in the dark and physical strain. Consider reviewing your itinerary:
1. Shorten daily distances or add extra camping nights.
2. Verify water source and campsite locations to ensure arrival in daylight.
3. If carrying a heavy pack, confirm your team has sufficient endurance for extended hours.

fast.title: Pace multiplier below 0.7 — extreme speed mode
fast.body:
Your itinerary is extremely tight with little buffer for unexpected situations. Please address the following in your plan:
1. Set a clear turn-around time — descend immediately if behind schedule.
2. Confirm all team members have equal fitness and load-carrying capacity.
3. For technical sections (scrambles, scree slopes), avoid applying this multiplier — use 1.0 for safety.
